scripts.build: bun run build:dist:clean && bun run build:types:force && bun run build:js
scripts.build:dist:clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist auth/*/dist connectors/*/dist broker/*/dist queues/*/dist sandboxes/*/dist storage/*/dist loggers/*/dist
scripts.build:clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/.tsbuild auth/*/dist auth/*/.tsbuild connectors/*/dist connectors/*/.tsbuild broker/*/dist broker/*/.tsbuild queues/*/dist queues/*/.tsbuild sandboxes/*/dist sandboxes/*/.tsbuild storage/*/dist storage/*/.tsbuild loggers/*/dist loggers/*/.tsbuild examples/*/.sixb
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.lint: biome check auth/*/src packages/*/src connectors/*/src sandboxes/*/src
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:types && bun run typecheck:tests && bun run typecheck:examples
scripts.generate:client: bun --filter @sixb/server generate:openapi && bun --filter @sixb/client generate && bun check:fix
